verdict.rationale: The installer writes skills into your repo as ordinary, editable files you own, and updates only arrive when you choose to run `npx skills update`. That implies you can version and review skill changes through your normal repo workflow. The alternative plugin route is a managed, read-only bundle that updates when the author ships, which reduces control. missing for 10: documented versioning or pinning of skill releases, a built-in review or diff step for incoming updates, an explicit rollback mechanism, independent hands-on corroboration.
